findings.body: When a finished Slack stream uses the snippet fallback, both successful-upload branches in channel-delivery.ts (lines 361–370 and 407–417) discard fallback.externalMessageId. That identifier is already returned by file-delivery.ts:130–138. This helper therefore returns either true or only earlier message IDs, and hasSentBotMessage cannot identify the uploaded answer by its message ID. Preserve the snippet receipt in both branches before constructing the completed stream result. The existing successful-upload test supplies no share timestamp, so it misses this case.
findings.title: Include successful Slack snippet receipts in completed stream results
